market.question: Will the 10-year Treasury yield hit 5.10% in September?

en.title: 10-Year Yield Hits 5.10%; PMI Fuels Spike
en.summary: The probability surged to 92% as the 10-year Treasury yield explicitly hit 5.10% in September. This spike was primarily driven by a stronger-than-expected U.S. composite PMI, which jumped to 58.4.
drivers: 10-year Treasury yield spiked to 5.10%.
U.S. composite PMI jumped to 58.4 in September.
Firms' input costs rose at steepest rate in four years.
en.why_matters: Elevated Treasury yields signal persistent inflation and a hawkish Federal Reserve, impacting borrowing costs and risk asset valuations globally.
en.bull_case: The 10-year yield already hit 5.10%, and strong economic data like the U.S. composite PMI suggests sustained upward pressure.
en.bear_case: Yields could retreat if upcoming economic data disappoints or if geopolitical events trigger a flight to safety.

drivers: 10年期国债收益率飙升至5.10%。
美国9月综合PMI跃升至58.4。
企业投入成本创四年最大涨幅。
zh.why_matters: 国债收益率高企预示着持续通胀和美联储鹰派立场，影响全球借贷成本和风险资产估值。
zh.bull_case: 10年期收益率已达5.10%，强劲经济数据如美国综合PMI预示持续上行压力。
zh.bear_case: 若未来经济数据不及预期或地缘政治事件引发避险，收益率可能回落。
